data.name: Bhimrao
data.gender_notes: Bhimrao is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Bhima, a character in the Mahabharata, Bhimrao means the possessor of the strength of a Brahmin. Bhima was the second of the five Pandava brothers and was known for his immense strength and courage. The name Bhimrao carries the meaning “Brahmin strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhimrao usually hope their child will grow to embody brahmin strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner and outer strength, bravery, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Bhimrao belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brahmin strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhimrao total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
